items.label: José María Córdova Airport
items.cost: Official airport taxi 132,000 COP (about $41). Uber or DiDi about $25 to $34.
items.note: 45 to 60 min to Poblado through the Túnel de Oriente. Use the white taxi queue outside arrivals, or pre-book a car.

items.label: Sloh Hotel & Bar Manila
items.note: Calle 12 #43D-114, Manila. Walkable base next to Provenza, full of restaurants.

items.label: Comuna 13 graffiti tour
items.cost: Group tour about $14 to $32 each. Private from about $90 each. Tip your guide.
items.note: Metro to San Javier. Pick a local-run group and book ahead.

items.label: Plaza Botero and Museo de Antioquia
items.cost: 30,000 to 40,000 COP each, about $19 to $25 for two. Sources differ.
items.note: Be back in Poblado before dusk. Centro gets sketchy after dark.

items.label: Dinner in Provenza
items.note: Dinner and rooftop drinks, walkable from the hotel. Use Uber or inDrive late at night.

items.label: Guatapé and El Peñol
items.when: Leave around 7 am, about 2 h each way
items.cost: Private vehicle $200 to $290 for two. Peñol entry 25,000 to 35,000 COP each, cash. Boat 25,000 to 35,000 COP each.
items.note: 740 steps. Get there before the tour buses. Treat salsa in Laureles as a bonus.

items.label: Parque Arví
items.cost: Park entry is free. Metro and cable about 25,000 to 35,000 COP each round trip, trail tickets extra. About $30 to $50 for two.
items.note: Metro A, Cable K, then Cable L. Roughly 1.5 h each way.

items.label: Pueblito Paisa
items.note: Taxi up from the base is about 10,000 to 15,000 COP.

items.label: Dinner at El Cielo
items.cost: The Experience 700,000 COP each (about $218). Wine pairing +330,000 or +460,000 COP each. About $436 for two, $642 to $723 with wine.
items.note: Calle 7D #43C-36, El Poblado. Book now, Saturday slots go first.

items.label: Jardín Botánico
items.note: Bring passports, the entrance checks ID. Open Tuesday to Sunday.

items.label: Back to the airport
items.when: Leave the hotel around 2:30 pm for the 5:49 pm flight (P5 7048)
items.cost: Same fare as arrival, about $41 by taxi.
items.note: Check your Wingo fare. The cheapest one covers only a small personal item.
